alerts.headline: Red Flag Warning issued November 10 at 11:17AM CST until November 11 at 6:00PM CST by NWS Austin/San Antonio TX
alerts.description:
...CRITICAL FIRE WEATHER CONDITIONS EXPECTED TUESDAY...

.The return of moderate to breezy southerly flow with the
continuation of a dry airmass over the area will combine to
result in critical fire weather conditions during Tuesday
across the majority of South Central Texas.

The National Weather Service in Austin/San Antonio has issued a
Red Flag Warning for breezy southerly winds and low humidity,
which is in effect from 9 AM to 6 PM CST Tuesday.

* AFFECTED AREA...Majority of South-Central Texas.

* TIMING...From 9 AM to 6 PM CST Tuesday.

* WINDS...South 10 to 20 mph with gusts up to 30 mph.

* RELATIVE HUMIDITY...15 to 25 percent.

* TEMPERATURES...Mid 60s to Mid 70s.

* IMPACTS...Any fires that develop will likely spread rapidly.
Outdoor burning is not recommended.

...RED FLAG WARNING IN EFFECT FROM 9 AM TO 6 PM CST TUESDAY FOR
WIND AND LOW RELATIVE HUMIDITY FOR PORTIONS OF THE BRAZOS VALLEY...

The National Weather Service in Houston/Galveston has issued a
Red Flag Warning for wind and low relative humidity, which is in
effect from 9 AM to 6 PM CST Tuesday.

* WINDS...Southeast 10 to 15 mph with gusts up to 25 mph.

* RELATIVE HUMIDITY...As low as 19 percent.

* IMPACTS...Any fires that develop will be capable of spreading
rapidly. Outdoor burning is not recommended. Obey all local burn
restrictions and burn bans.

alerts.headline: Red Flag Warning issued November 10 at 11:17AM CST until November 11 at 6:00PM CST by NWS Austin/San Antonio TX
alerts.description:
...CRITICAL FIRE WEATHER CONDITIONS EXPECTED TUESDAY...

.The return of moderate to breezy southerly flow with the
continuation of a dry airmass over the area will combine to
result in critical fire weather conditions during Tuesday
across the majority of South Central Texas.

The National Weather Service in Austin/San Antonio has issued a
Red Flag Warning for breezy southerly winds and low humidity,
which is in effect from 9 AM to 6 PM CST Tuesday.

* AFFECTED AREA...Majority of South-Central Texas.

* TIMING...From 9 AM to 6 PM CST Tuesday.

* WINDS...South 10 to 20 mph with gusts up to 30 mph.

* RELATIVE HUMIDITY...15 to 25 percent.

* TEMPERATURES...Mid 60s to Mid 70s.

* IMPACTS...Any fires that develop will likely spread rapidly.
Outdoor burning is not recommended.

alerts.headline: Red Flag Warning issued November 10 at 11:58AM CST until November 11 at 6:00PM CST by NWS Corpus Christi TX
alerts.description:
...RED FLAG WARNING IN EFFECT FOR MOST OF THE BRUSH COUNTRY ON
TUESDAY...

.Relative humidity will drop through the day on Tuesday, reaching
a minimum of 20-30% across portions of the Brush Country. In
addition to dry conditions, southerly winds of 15-20 mph with
gusts up to 25 mph will be present in the afternoon. Lastly, fuel
moisture will be very dry in the less than 10th percentile.

The National Weather Service in Corpus Christi has issued a Red
Flag Warning for critical fire weather conditions, which is in
effect from 10 AM to 6 PM CST Tuesday.

* AFFECTED AREA...La Salle, McMullen, Webb and Duval.

* TIMING...10 AM to 6 PM CST Tuesday

* WINDS...South 15-20 mph with gusts up to 25 mph.

* RELATIVE HUMIDITY...As low as 20 percent.

* TEMPERATURES...Up to 78.

* IMPACTS...Any fires that develop will likely spread rapidly.
Outdoor burning is not recommended
